# Setup
```{r}
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(survey)
library(gtsummary)
source(here("R", "derive_variables.R"))
```

## Load data and derive variables
```{r}
df_all <- derive_variable(readRDS(here("data", "derived", "nhanes_merged.rds")))
```

## Survey designs            
```{r}
design_hba1c_full <- svydesign(id = ~SDMVPSU, strata = ~SDMVSTRA, weights = ~wt_hba1c,
                               nest = TRUE, data = df_all)
design_hba1c <- subset(design_hba1c_full,
  ELIGSTAT == 1 & RIDSTATR == 2 & RIDAGEYR >= 20 & PERMTH_EXM > 0 & !is.na(LBXGH))

design_crp_full <- svydesign(id = ~SDMVPSU, strata = ~SDMVSTRA, weights = ~wt_crp,
                             nest = TRUE, data = df_all)
design_crp <- subset(design_crp_full,
  ELIGSTAT == 1 & RIDSTATR == 2 & RIDAGEYR >= 20 & PERMTH_EXM > 0 & !is.na(LBXCRP))
```

## variables and lables
```{r}
vars <- c("RIDAGEYR", "sex", "race_eth", "education", "INDFMPIR", "BMXBMI",
          "smoking", "diabetes_dx", "LBXGH", "LBXCRP")
lab <- list(
    RIDAGEYR ~ "Age (years)",
    sex ~ "Sex",
    race_eth ~ "Race / ethnicity",
    education ~ "Education",
    INDFMPIR ~ "Income-to-poverty ratio",
    BMXBMI ~ "BMI (kg/m²)",
    smoking ~ "Smoking status",
    diabetes_dx ~ "Diagnosed diabetes",
    LBXGH ~ "HbA1c (%)",
    LBXCRP ~ "CRP (mg/L)"
  )
```

## Table 1 – CRP branch
```{r}
tbl_crp <- tbl_svysummary(
  design_crp,
  by = crp_cat,   
  include = all_of(vars),
  label = lab,
  statistic = list(all_continuous() ~ "{median} ({p25}, {p75})",
                   all_categorical() ~ "{p}%"),
  digits = all_continuous() ~ 1,
  missing = "ifany",
  missing_text = "Missing"
) %>% 
  add_overall()

```

## Table 1 – HbA1c branch
```{r}
tbl_hba1c <- tbl_svysummary(
  design_hba1c,
  include = all_of(vars),
  label = lab,
  statistic = list(all_continuous() ~ "{median} ({p25}, {p75})",
                   all_categorical() ~ "{p}%"),
  digits = all_continuous() ~ 1,
  missing = "ifany",
  missing_text = "Missing"
) 

```


## Visualizations
```{r}
cat_vars <- c(sex = "Sex", race_eth = "Race / ethnicity", education = "Education",
              smoking = "Smoking status", diabetes_dx = "Diagnosed diabetes")

d <- design_crp$variables
d$w <- weights(design_crp)

# order of x labels: variable, then its levels
lvl_order <- unlist(lapply(names(cat_vars), function(v)
  paste(cat_vars[[v]], levels(d[[v]]), sep = " - ")))

props <- d %>%
  select(SDDSRVYR, crp_cat, w, all_of(names(cat_vars))) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(names(cat_vars)), as.character)) %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(names(cat_vars)), names_to = "var", values_to = "level") %>%
  filter(!is.na(level)) %>%
  group_by(var, SDDSRVYR, crp_cat) %>%
  mutate(den = sum(w)) %>%                      # weighted denominator (non-missing only)
  group_by(var, level, SDDSRVYR, crp_cat) %>%
  summarise(prop = sum(w) / first(den), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(var_lab = cat_vars[var],
         label = factor(paste(var_lab, level, sep = " - "), levels = lvl_order))

ggplot(props, aes(x = label, y = prop, fill = crp_cat)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.7, linewidth = 0.3, outlier.size = 0.8) +
  facet_grid(~var_lab, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Blues", name = "CRP") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Weighted proportion across NHANES cycles",
       caption = "Each box summarises 8 cycle-specific weighted proportions.") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top", panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
